name: fixing-motion-performance
description: Fix animation jank and layout thrashing — compositor-only properties, will-change hints, avoiding layout-triggering CSS, GPU layer promotion, requestAnimationFrame usage, reduced-motion support, and auditing with DevTools Performance panel. Use when asked to "animation is janky", "fix animation performance", "layout thrashing", "GPU acceleration", "will-change", "compositor layer", "60fps animations", "CSS animation vs JS animation", "prefers-reduced-motion", "scroll performance", or "why is my transition slow". Do NOT use for: accessibility of motion — see fixing-accessibility. Do NOT use for: designing animation curves and timing — see motion-design.
